usedFor: StoreHippo holds your orders, and Google Sheets receives a row when “New Order” runs “Add New Row to Sheet”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Every new order lands as a spreadsheet row, so the team can sort and total sales.

watchOut: “Add New Row to Sheet” maps values by header or column letter, so confirm the mapping before orders arrive.
